title: Remove profile setup flow and refresh UI styling

requirements.text: Remove the profile setup flow so authenticated users are never prompted to complete a "Set up your profile" dialog, and the app remains usable even when the caller has no saved profile.
acceptanceCriteria: After login, the app navigates directly to the main AppShell without showing any profile setup modal/dialog.
There are no UI elements labeled "Set up your profile" or "Welcome! Set up your profile" in the running app.
If getCallerUserProfile returns null, the header area does not show a broken/empty profile section and the rest of the app functions normally (tabs/pages load).

requirements.text: Update/change the user interface with a cohesive, consistent visual refresh across the login screen, header, tab navigation, page surfaces, and dialogs (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling). Use English for all user-facing text.
acceptanceCriteria: The updated UI applies a consistent theme across: LoginPage, AppShell header, TabsList/TabsTrigger navigation, and page content containers.
Dialogs/popups use a solid, non-transparent surface with readable foreground text in both light and dark mode.
Dashboard tabs have a consistent accent color for active/hover/focus states and an obvious active indicator.
No user-facing strings introduced by this change are non-English.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources); compose them via props/className or via project CSS.
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts / .tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep backend architecture as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional canisters/services.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Do not add new profile editing features/screens unless explicitly requested.
Do not change backend data models or add migrations as part of this UI-only request.
